rows.text: calls `00184E60(rcx + 8)`, stores the address `00902ED8` at qword `+0x0` of `rcx` and the dword `0x3F800000` at `+0xC8` and `+0xD0`, calls `001F0A00(rcx)` and returns `rcx`

notes: 001EF280: 0x3F800000 is stored as an integer immediate; the listing does not decode it, so the row keeps the hex value (it is the bit pattern of 1.0f).
